Scalar text is an Ast Text handle, type values are TypeTable handles, qualified-name rendering reuses the Ast renderer, and generic substitution reuses TypeTable structural substitution rather than scanning identifiers a second time.
source_owner: caller Ast for expression, list, and Text handles / Checker for TypeTable, metadata, captures, and owner map / caller for returned Diagnostic
cleanup: ComptimeValue and all handles need no cleanup; qualified names, split static arguments, and dynamic message Strings use defer or errdefer; a successful substitution String is deinitialized after predicate evaluation; returned Diagnostic moves once to the caller and Checker.deinit releases retained phase state
